# Paul Ann Media

> A full-service, AI-native media group. Websites, social campaigns, marketing
> strategy, lead generation, content systems, and AI visibility. A Trimmie
> Holdings company, sister to Paul Ann Labs.

## What this company does

Paul Ann Media builds demand — audience, brand, and pipeline — for client
businesses across industries. It is not limited to any single vertical. The firm
also builds and operates its own products, notably HomeTimeJobs, a CDL driver
platform.

## Services

- Websites — static-first builds, fast, fully readable by search and AI crawlers
- Social campaigns — channel selection, content calendars, sustainable cadence
- Marketing strategy — audience, positioning, sequencing, channel selection
- Lead generation — qualified prospects, defined standards, outcome pricing
- Content systems — editorial engines that keep running after an engagement ends
- AI visibility — schema markup, structured data, llms.txt, crawler configuration

## Key pages

- /services — detail on each of the six service lines and how pricing works
- /work — owned products and client engagement approach
- /about — origin, company family structure, operating principles

## Positions this company takes

- Marketing advice is better from operators than from consultants. The firm was
  built inside a working company applying AI to real operations.
- Advertising spend should be paid by the client directly to the platform, never
  marked up through the agency.
- A qualified lead must be defined before it is priced. Cheap unqualified volume
  costs more than no leads.
- Most companies still optimize only for search engines while discovery moves
  toward AI models. Structured data and crawler access matter now.
- Not every business problem is a marketing problem, and saying so is part of the job.

## Company family

Trimmie Holdings is the parent. Paul Ann Media handles demand and audience.
Paul Ann Labs handles operations — AI deployed inside the business itself.
HomeTimeJobs is an owned product of Paul Ann Media.
